It also announces the appointment of Ms. Nicosia as the audit committee financial expert following Matthew McKenna's retirement, highlighting her qualifications in finance and accounting. Additionally, the report outlines the inclusion of Exhibit No. 104, which contains financial data in an interactive XBRL format.

children.title: Shareholder Vote Results from Annual Meeting
children.summary: This section details the outcomes of the shareholder votes at Foot Locker, Inc.'s annual meeting held on May 18, 2022. It includes the total number of shares entitled to vote, the quorum achieved, and the results of four specific proposals. The proposals covered the election of ten Board nominees, approval of named executive officers' compensation, the frequency of future advisory votes on compensation, and the ratification of KPMG LLP as the independent auditor. Each proposal's voting results, including votes for, against, abstentions, and broker non-votes, are provided, confirming the approval of all proposals.

children.title: Appointment of Audit Committee Financial Expert
children.summary: On May 18, 2022, the Board appointed Ms. Nicosia as the audit committee financial expert following Matthew McKenna's retirement. Ms. Nicosia was deemed qualified under the Securities Exchange Act due to her extensive experience in finance and accounting, including her role as president of a multinational corporation. She has a strong background in analyzing financial statements and internal controls, and has served on the Company’s Audit Committee. The Board noted that other directors may also meet the qualifications for this designation.
children.text:
[page 3]
 
 
 
  
Item 8.01.
Other Events.
 
On May 18, 2022, in light of Matthew
McKenna’s retirement, the Board designated Ms. Nicosia as the “audit committee financial expert.” In
connection with
this designation, the Board determined that Ms. Nicosia qualifies as an “audit committee financial expert,” as defined by
the rules under
the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), because of her relevant experience as
president of an operating unit of a large
multinational corporation. She has supervised the finance and accounting professionals responsible
for, and personally analyzed and evaluated, financial
statements, as well as internal controls over financial reporting. She is also familiar
with audit committee functions through her service on the Company’s
Audit Committee. The Board also believes that there are other
directors who would also qualify for this designation.
